description:
Build the "Broadcast" dashboard — marketing, growth, and audience metrics. This dashboard has the most gaps — it will start mostly aspirational and fill in as marketing team tooling matures.

**Theme: Signal Tower**
Electric purple and magenta on dark background. Radiating wave animations from a central broadcast point. Social platform icons subtly integrated. Conversion funnel as luminous narrowing beam. Visitor counts as flowing particles. Conveys reach and energy.

**Metrics — Available Now (dataSource: live, ~40% coverage):**
- LPBS analytics: total visitors (distinct sessions), total downloads
- Conversion rate by variant (A/B testing performance)
- Per-variant breakdown: views, CTA clicks, conversions, downloads, scroll depth
- Top CTAs with click-through rates
- Time-windowed analytics (7/30/90 day)
- Feedback volume by type (refund/bug/feature/general)
- User registration trends (users.created_at)

**Metrics — Ideal/Future (dataSource: gap):**
- Social media follower counts (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube) — from social-media-scheduler team
- Post engagement metrics (likes, shares, comments per platform)
- Optimal posting time analysis
- SEO metrics: keyword rankings, organic traffic, domain authority — from seo-optimizer team
- Funnel conversion rates per step — from funnel-builder team
- Campaign performance: which campaigns drove which conversions — from campaign-content-studio team
- Email open/click rates
- Content production velocity (pieces per week)
- Brand consistency scores across scenarios — from brand-manager team
- Referral source breakdown (organic/social/paid/direct)
- CAC (customer acquisition cost)
- Video view-through rates — from video-studio team (planned)

**Note:** The gap tracking system makes the high gap ratio a feature, not a bug — each gap is a signal for what to build next.

**Layout concept:** Central funnel visualization (visitors → clicks → conversions → downloads). Social platform cards around perimeter. Campaign performance timeline. SEO health indicators. Content calendar heatmap.
name: command-center-broadcast-page
title: Build Broadcast dashboard — marketing and growth with Signal Tower theme
